hero.titleLine2: Connected to nearby devices through your desktop.
hero.body: Send and receive through MeshDrop at <mono>{{host}}</mono>. Choose a nearby device and keep MeshDrop open there. The first transfer needs pairing approval on the receiving device.

discovery.anonymousVisitor: Files are forwarded by this device
discovery.selectedHint: Selected {{who}} — drag files or paste text to send

dropZone.targetHint: Target: {{who}} · drag files / folders to send directly
dropZone.defaultHint: ⤓ Folders work too · single file up to 4 GB · text / links accepted

paste.title: Paste text / link
paste.placeholder: Paste text, a link, or a code snippet to send to the selected device…

toast.filesQueued: {{count}} files queued for {{who}}. Follow the transfer status below and approve pairing or receipt on the phone.

chat.selectToStart: Select a device to start chatting
chat.composerPlaceholder: Write a message… · Enter to send

receive.incomingWantsToSend: Incoming · {{who}} wants to send to you

transfer.headline: {{total}} tasks{{progress}} · <done>{{done}}</done>
transfer.waitingApproval: Waiting for connection, pairing or receipt. Open MeshDrop on the other device and confirm.

clipboard.headline: Push a snippet of text to nearby devices
clipboard.subtitle: Explicit push — it only sends when you tap, not a silent background sync. Links / code / plain text are auto-categorized.
clipboard.composerPlaceholder: Paste or type what you want to push…

history.headline: {{total}} things happened on this browser
history.subtitle: As a guest, history lives only in memory — closing the browser clears it. For permanent records, enable it on the native side.

pairing.intro: Enter the six-character pairing code from Settings → Web access in the desktop app to use LAN transfers through this device.

gateway.notConfigured: No native Web Gateway configured. Enter the address of a running MeshDrop native client before pairing.
gateway.needGateway: Set the native Web Gateway address first
gateway.urlScheme: Gateway URL must start with http:// or https://

code.hint: Find the 6-character code at the top of the native app and enter it here
code.label: ● 6-char code · 30s
code.unknown: No pairing code from the gateway yet.

pairing.fingerprintPeerSame: Peer should see the same 8 groups
pairing.fingerprintUnknown: Gateway hasn't reported a fingerprint yet — nothing to verify against.
pairing.qrUnavailable: QR unavailable — use the 6-character code instead.

s1.title: Same local network
s1.body: Make sure both devices are on the same Wi-Fi or switch, with no client isolation.

s2.title: Connect this browser
s2.body: Sign in with the address and code in Mac Settings → Web access. The browser does not generate a phone pairing code.

s3.title: Approve on your phone
s3.body: Open MeshDrop on your phone. Verify the gateway fingerprint, approve first-time pairing, then accept the file. Follow the result in Transfers.

pairing.connectedBody: This browser sends and receives through this device. On your first transfer to a phone, open MeshDrop there and approve pairing and receipt.
pairing.startSending: Choose a device and send files

settings.subtitle: Guest preferences apply only to the current tab. For preferences that sync across devices, configure them on the native side.

visibility.showInRadarHint: Local preference only · the actual mDNS broadcast is controlled by the native side. Turning it off only remembers the choice in this browser.
visibility.scopeHint: Local preference only · real access control must be set on the native side; this just persists across refreshes.
visibility.rememberBrowserHint: Off means cleared on close (recommended). On keeps the session token so auto-reconnect works; turning it off clears it immediately.

security.autoAccept: Auto-accept file offers from unpaired devices
security.autoAcceptHint: Not recommended · only enable when you fully control the LAN.
security.notifyHint: Requires browser notification permission; off means no popup even if permission is granted.

session.confirmText: Disconnecting clears the local session token; next visit requires re-entering the 6-character pairing code. Continue?

receiveBehavior.defaultPathHint: Local preference only · the browser can only write to the Downloads folder; for other paths use the native side.
receiveBehavior.keepHistory: Keep session history until tab closes
receiveBehavior.keepHistoryHint: Local preference only · history stays in memory and is never written to disk; cleared on close.

about.engine: engine · Native Web Gateway · LAN plaintext v0.1 · {{mode}}
